biologia-molecular.resumen: Molecular Biology is a key tool for precision diagnosis: it impacts prognosis and therapeutic selection. Our service integrates validated molecular techniques in close correlation with anatomopathological findings, ensuring reliable results aligned with current scientific standards.

destacados.detalle: The BenchMark ULTRA is the most innovative and fully automated in situ hybridization slide staining system from Roche Tissue Diagnostics. Individual sliding drawers for one-piece workflow and a menu of over 250 ready-to-use assays.

Improved quality of life and increased chances in pregnancy management.

inmunohistoquimica.resumen: An essential tool for modern anatomic pathology: tumor typing, evaluation of prognostic and predictive factors — providing decisive information for classification and clinical decisions. We use standardized techniques with automated protocols on Ventana's BenchMark Ultra platform, with monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies and rigorous quality controls.

hero.title: We're with you every step.
hero.description: A biopsy or cytology request can raise questions. Here you'll find clear information on what each study is, how to prepare, and how to pick up your report.

bloques.title: What is a biopsy?
bloques.text: It's the microscopic study of a tissue or cell sample obtained by a physician. Our pathologists analyze it to establish an accurate diagnosis that guides treatment.

bloques.title: How long does the report take?
bloques.text: Most studies are delivered within 24 to 72 business hours. More complex studies (immunohistochemistry, molecular biology) may require additional time.

bloques.title: How do I pick up my report?
bloques.text: The report is delivered to your referring physician; you can also pick it up in person with your ID or request it by email with proof of identity.

bloques.title: Where are we?

pacientes.faqFooter: Didn't find what you were looking for?

faqs.q: Do I need an appointment to drop off a sample?
faqs.a: No appointment needed. You can come Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 20:00. For surgical specimens or material with special requirements, we coordinate pickup by phone.

faqs.q: What should I bring on the day of the sample?
faqs.a: Yes: the original medical order, your ID, and your health insurance credential if applicable. If you have related prior studies, bring them too.
The original report is sent to your referring physician. You can pick up a copy with your ID, request it by email, or check by phone.

faqs.q: Do you work with my insurer?
faqs.a: We work with the main insurers, HMOs, and hospitals in the country. See the full list in the Coverage section or call us to confirm your coverage.

faqs.q: What if my doctor requests a second opinion?
faqs.a: We accept consultations and second opinions on material already processed at another laboratory. Bring the paraffin blocks and original slides along with the previous report.

faqs.q: Can I request the same report years later?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep slides and paraffin blocks for the periods required by current regulations. You can request a copy of the report or the original material with proof of identity.

faqs.q: How do you protect my data?
faqs.a: We operate under Law 25.326 on Personal Data Protection. Your clinical information is confidential and only shared with you and your treating physician.
